effects.instruction: Narrator only: Battle Trial round 4 of 5 is on now: Team H (Fumikage Tokoyami and Tsuyu Asui) as heroes against Team C (Momo Yaoyorozu and Minoru Mineta) as villains. Only Momo Yaoyorozu and Minoru Mineta are villains; nobody else joins them. Already fought, never again: Teams A, D, J, E, B, I. Announce and play only this matchup. When it ends, the next round is Team G (Kyoka Jiro and Denki Kaminari) against Team F (Koji Koda and Rikido Sato); Teams A, D, J, E, B, I, H, C are then done and never drawn again. The exercise is NOT over after this round: 1 more round remains. When this round ends, close the turn with its result and a short review; announce the next round only on the following turn.
